bar_share.note: the acceptance bar: share of pixels whose worst channel is >8 levels off, worst frame of a spread sample

bar_peak.note: the peak bar; NOT the 8-level threshold that defines a bad pixel

gate_ratio.note: the int8 ceiling with a scalar epilogue - a speedup, so never a share

kill_prob.note: P(pass) below this and the lane is not worth its probe

zero_excess.note: a margin bar: the excess must be at or below zero

bar_slope_span.note: beyond +-2 the PReLU is no longer a leaky rectifier
